assessment: This fundamental work provides a comprehensive look at validity of the Proportional Recovery Rule, which states that patients will recover a fixed proportion of lost function after stroke. By undertaking a thorough investigation of the statistical properties of the analysis of change and baseline values the authors elucidate the statistical framework that can be used regardless of the topic of study. In a compelling model comparison across several large sets of data, the authors confirm support for the Proportional Recovery Rule over other models of recovery.
